itemUses.label: Item Uses
itemUses.nonEmbeddedHint: Item identifier or UUID of item in compendium that will be linked automatically to matching item on sheet.

material.label: Material
material.nonEmbeddedHint: Item identifier or UUID of item in compendium that will be linked automatically to matching item on sheet.

attribute.label: Attribute
attribute.nonEmbeddedHint: Path of the attribute to consume (e.g. attributes.exhaustion, spells.pact.value).

all.label: All Effects
all.hint: Keep all effects, ignoring any other effects settings.

origin.label: This Actor
origin.hint: Keep any effects created directly on this source actor.

otherOrigin.label: Other Actors
otherOrigin.hint: Keep any effects imposed by an outside actor.

physical.label: Physical Abilities
physical.hint: Keep strength, dexterity, and constitution scores.

mental.label: Mental Abilities
mental.hint: Keep intelligence, wisdom, and charisma scores.

self.label: Self
self.hint: Only change portrait and token artwork, other settings will be ignored.

expertise.label: Expertise
expertise.hint: Gain expertise in a trait in which you already have proficiency.

forcedExpertise.label: Forced Expertise
forcedExpertise.hint: Gain expertise in a trait regardless of your previous proficiency level.

upgrade.label: Upgrade
upgrade.hint: Gain proficiency in a trait unless you already have it, otherwise gain expertise.

mastery.label: Mastery
mastery.hint: Gain mastery with a weapon in which you already have proficiency.

diamondSoul.name: Diamond Soul
diamondSoul.hint: Gain proficiency to all saving throws.

enhancedDualWielding.name: Enhanced Dual Wielding
enhancedDualWielding.hint: Allow bonus action extra attacks using any melee weapon without the Two-Handed property.

elvenAccuracy.name: Elven Accuracy
elvenAccuracy.hint: Roll an extra d20 with advantage to Dex, Int, Wis, or Cha.

halflingLucky.name: Halfling Lucky
halflingLucky.hint: Reroll ones when rolling d20 checks.

halflingNimbleness.name: Halfling Nimbleness
halflingNimbleness.hint: Movement through larger creatures is not blocked.

jackOfAllTrades.name: Jack of All Trades
jackOfAllTrades.hint: Half-Proficiency to Ability Checks in which you are not already Proficient.

observantFeat.name: Observant Feat
observantFeat.hint: Provides a +5 to passive Perception and Investigation.

remarkableAthlete.name: Remarkable Athlete
remarkableAthlete.hint: Half-Proficiency (rounded-up) to physical Ability Checks and Initiative.

toolExpertise.name: Tool Expertise
toolExpertise.hint: Doubles your proficiency bonus for any ability check you make that uses your proficiency with a tool.

weaponCriticalThreshold.name: Weapon Critical Hit Threshold
weaponCriticalThreshold.hint: An expanded critical hit threshold for weapon attacks.

spellCriticalThreshold.name: Spell Critical Hit Threshold
spellCriticalThreshold.hint: An expanded critical hit threshold for spell attacks.

meleeCriticalDamageDice.name: Melee Critical Damage Dice
meleeCriticalDamageDice.hint: A number of additional damage dice added to melee weapon critical hits.
